caption: A hand holds an open, gray velvet-lined ring box outdoors against a blurred green-grass background. Inside the box sits a ring with a cushion-cut, faintly blue-tinted center stone held by four prongs, mounted on a pavé-diamond band. The box and ring are already in motion, with the viewing angle shifting gradually from a three-quarter side view toward a more frontal perspective. As the angle changes, the inner lid's embossed diamond-shaped 'BG' logo becomes visible at the top. Specular highlights and facet sparkle on the center stone and pavé band shift position and intensity, including brief bright and greenish flashes. The box shifts slightly, while the holding fingers remain visible at the edges. The ring stays securely seated in the velvet slot, untouched and not removed.
